subject: GitHub integration & connector questions
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex@openforge.dev>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GitHub integration & connector questions

Hi Jordan,

I signed up for a trial this morning (OpenForge) and I have a couple of quick questions about the GitHub connector before we spin anything up for our security folks. We're evaluating Redwood for inference on some public and private repos and I want to confirm:

- Do you support installing via a GitHub App for org-level access?
- Can the connector be restricted to certain repos and non-admin installation?
- Is there a way to demo the Actions-based flow that triggers inference from CI?

Happy to hop on a short call — I'm Alex (Head of Platform) at OpenForge. My timezone is PST.

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Head of Platform, OpenForge
alex@openforge.dev

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@openforge.dev>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GitHub integration & connector questions

Thanks for the note, Alex — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. I can cover the high-level install patterns and bring a solutions engineer for a short technical walkthrough. A couple of quick Qs that will help us focus the session:

- Are you evaluating for public repos only, or a mix of public + private?
- Approximate repo count / typical repo size (codebase MBs)?
- Do you need an on-prem/private deployment for the connector itself, or is Hosted acceptable while you evaluate?

If it helps, here's my 30-min calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-30min — otherwise share a few slots that work and I'll loop in the right folks.

I can bring Marissa (solutions) for the demo and Jonas (account) for any procurement questions — copying Marissa on the follow-up if that works.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Alex Kim <alex@openforge.dev>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GitHub integration & connector questions

Thanks Jordan — quick answers below:

- It's a mix: ~12 public repos and ~8 private repos for now.
- Most repos are small-to-medium (10-200MB).
- Hosted is fine for the initial eval; we may need private options later for compliance.

We definitely want to see the Actions flow and the repo-scoped install. For the call, we'd have myself and our lead SRE (Priya) join.

Availability (PST): Wed 3/3 afternoon (1–5pm) or Thu 3/4 morning (8–11am).

Also — any pre-demo checklist I should send to Priya?

Cheers,
Alex
